This Writ Petition has been filed seeking a direction to the 3rd respondent to consider the past service of the petitioner as a Technical Officer on contractual basis under the 5th respondent from T.Balaji vs Union Of India on 16 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76521363/
2 01.01.2013 to 14.02.2021 and consider the petitioner's seniority with the present appointment of the petitioner as a Technical Officer on direct recruitment with effect from 15.02.2021 as claimed in his representation dated 19.05.2023. 
2. The case of the petitioner is that, he was appointed as a Technical Officer on 20.07.2012 in the respondent management on contract basis and his contract was renewed by the 3rd respondent periodically from 20.07.2012 to 14.02.2021 without any break in the service. In the meanwhile, the petitioner was appointed as Technical Officer through direct recruitment on 21.01.2021 and the 3rd respondent relieved him on 15.02.2021 where he worked as Technical Officer on contract since 20.07.2012 to 14.02.2021 without any gap. After relieving, the petitioner joined as Technical Officer with effect from 15.02.2021 at https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis FSSAI, New Delhi, from contract to regular appointment. However, his seniority has not been fixed from the date of his appointment as Technical Officer on contract basis. Hence, the petitioner submitted a detailed representation to the 3rd respondent on 19.05.2023. Till date, the representation has not been considered by the respondent. Hence, the present writ petition has been filed. 
3. The Learned Deputy Solicitor General appearing for R2 to R5 would submit that, the representation of the petitioner will be considered and appropriate orders will be passed, on merits and in accordance with law, within a time which may be fixed by this Court.
4. In view of the submission made by the Learned Deputy Solicitor General, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this Court directs the 3rd respondent to consider the petitioner's representation dated 19.05.2023 and pass appropriate orders, on merits and in accordance with law,
within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. 
5. Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed of. No costs. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 16.12.2024 raja Index : yes/no Internet : yes/no To 1. The Secretary, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, 156, 'A' Wing, Nirman Bhavan, New Delhi  110 011.
